headline: EasyEquities is still offline; it says partner apps may need relinking and it cannot promise compensation for missed trades.
summary: Update. Re-read EasyEquities' help page (s001) in a browser at about 8:14 AM ET: now "Last updated: 14:05 27 November 2026". Funds wording now "client funds and assets are accounted for and secure" (c003, q002). Withdrawals now "reopen only once each payment provider has passed a test transaction" (c007, q006; head updated). Still assessing whether personal information was accessed (q004 open); still working through legal and regulatory obligations. headline: EasyEquities says a security incident hit some of its systems; clients have been locked out since Nov 26 and the platform is still offline.
summary: New incident page. EasyEquities' help page (s001, last updated Nov 27) says it became aware of a security incident affecting some of its systems, is investigating with independent specialists, has restricted client login and some services and is keeping the platform offline; it is assessing whether personal information was accessed; it says all client funds are accounted for; trades go through its trading desk and some withdrawals may be delayed; the incident is not related to its brand refresh. TechCentral (s002) quotes the client email and the company's update that it is not related to the September provider breach; EWN (s003) reports the platform kept offline and calls it a second apparent cyberattack. September breach from EasyEquities' own page (s004); company facts from Purple Group (s005). Main answer Not established, filed under unclear: the company has not said that anyone got in. incident_type outage; service down on c002. Size Large.
